text_block_list.text:
One evening, right before the spring G1
races
begin, Мэдзиро Райан is feeling lost
in regards to her
future goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I listen to her intently and guide her
towards
focusing on what she truly
wants.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Confronting her inner self, she decides
she wants
to become a superstar racer,
just like Mejiro
McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her still naive and fragile spirit,
she
begins sprinting toward the grueling
spring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
